Numbers match the card: 16.1% of 849 claims, expected 2.9%, risk score 7.54, z 1.71, 36% low complexity, 16 documented claims, 4 documented 99215s, 2 of 9 with no lab. The cited claims fit the sentences citing them: C0078291 and C0078450 are Z09, C0078442 is M54.50, C0078461 is J06.9, and C0078513 and C0078838 are high-complexity. The language is cautious and the leaning is inconclusive, which is appropriate. It also flags thin documentation. Weaknesses are minor. The next steps are generic (a larger sample, re-screen) and do not name the specific claims, even though the rationale does suggest charts for the low-complexity 99215s. The rationale and next steps are slightly inconsistent. Two of the cited claims are not the strongest examples.","problems":["Next steps are generic and do not name the specific low-complexity 99215 claims that the rationale recommends pulling first.","The rationale says to request charts for low-complexity 99215 claims, while next_steps says to request a larger sample of 99214 and 99215 claims, so the guidance is inconsistent.","The comparison figure of 14% for other providers is not on the card as such (the card shows 0.136 as the all-provider 99215 rate), so it is a loose reading, though plausible.","The example claims chosen by code (C0078177 asthma and C0078204 R10.9) are not clearly the strongest low-complexity examples and add little beyond the narrative.","'Every complexity tier' is slightly overstated: the 0-condition band is 7.1% vs 2.2%, which is elevated, but the statement is not framed with those band numbers.","The by-complexity numbers are not cited in the summary even though they would support the headline."]}
